chapters.title: Be strong and courageous
chapters.summary: After Moses' death, God commissions Joshua to lead Israel across the Jordan, promising to be with him as He was with Moses if he keeps the law.

chapters.title: Rahab and the spies
chapters.summary: Two spies enter Jericho and are hidden by Rahab, who confesses faith in Israel's God. They promise to spare her family if she ties a scarlet cord in her window.

chapters.title: Crossing the Jordan
chapters.summary: When the priests carrying the ark step into the flooded Jordan, the waters stop and pile up, and all Israel crosses on dry ground.

chapters.title: Twelve memorial stones
chapters.summary: Twelve stones are taken from the riverbed and set up at Gilgal so that future children will ask what they mean and learn what God did.

chapters.title: Circumcision and the commander
chapters.summary: The new generation is circumcised at Gilgal and keeps Passover, and the manna stops. Joshua meets the commander of the Lord's army and is told to remove his sandals.

chapters.title: The fall of Jericho
chapters.summary: Israel marches around Jericho for seven days. On the seventh, the priests blow trumpets, the people shout, and the walls fall. Rahab and her family are spared.

chapters.title: Achan's sin
chapters.summary: Israel is defeated at Ai because Achan secretly kept forbidden plunder from Jericho. His sin is exposed and judged.

chapters.title: The capture of Ai
chapters.summary: Using an ambush, Israel takes Ai. Joshua builds an altar on Mount Ebal and reads the whole law to the people.

chapters.title: The Gibeonite trick
chapters.summary: The Gibeonites pretend to come from a distant land and make a treaty with Israel, because the leaders did not ask counsel of the Lord.

chapters.title: The sun stands still
chapters.summary: Five Amorite kings attack Gibeon. Joshua comes to its defense, and God sends hailstones and makes the sun stand still until the battle is won.

chapters.title: The northern campaign
chapters.summary: Israel defeats a great northern alliance at the waters of Merom, and Joshua takes the whole land as the Lord had told Moses.

chapters.title: Defeated kings
chapters.summary: A list of the kings defeated by Moses east of the Jordan and by Joshua west of it, thirty-one in all.

chapters.title: Land still to take
chapters.summary: Joshua is old and much land remains. God promises to drive out its peoples, and the inheritance east of the Jordan is described.

chapters.title: Caleb's inheritance
chapters.summary: The land west of the Jordan is divided by lot. Caleb, now eighty-five, asks for the hill country of Hebron that Moses promised him.

chapters.title: Judah's land
chapters.summary: The boundaries and towns of Judah's territory are listed, including Caleb's conquest of Hebron and his daughter Achsah's request for springs.

chapters.title: Ephraim's land
chapters.summary: The territory given to the descendants of Joseph, beginning with Ephraim, who did not drive out the Canaanites of Gezer.

chapters.title: Manasseh's land
chapters.summary: The western half of Manasseh receives its land, including Zelophehad's daughters. Joseph's tribes are told to clear the forested hill country.

chapters.title: Benjamin's land
chapters.summary: The tabernacle is set up at Shiloh. The remaining land is surveyed, and Benjamin's territory between Judah and Joseph is assigned.

chapters.title: The other tribes' land
chapters.summary: Simeon, Zebulun, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and Dan receive their portions. Joshua is given the town he asks for.

chapters.title: Cities of refuge
chapters.summary: Six cities of refuge are set apart, where someone who kills by accident can be protected until tried.

chapters.title: Every promise kept
chapters.summary: The Levites receive forty-eight towns. God gives Israel rest, and not one of all His good promises fails.

chapters.title: The altar by the Jordan
chapters.summary: The eastern tribes return home and build an altar by the Jordan, nearly causing war, until they explain it is a witness that they too worship the Lord.

chapters.title: Joshua's farewell
chapters.summary: Joshua, old and near death, urges Israel's leaders to hold fast to the Lord, love Him, and not mix with the nations' gods.

chapters.title: As for me and my house
chapters.summary: At Shechem Joshua retells Israel's story and calls them to choose whom they will serve. The people renew the covenant. Joshua dies and Joseph's bones are buried.
